title: Seconds → H:MM:SS
hints: Split the seconds with integer division and remainder: `h = s / 3600`, `m = s % 3600 / 60`, `sec = s % 60`. Turn each number into text with `std::to_string`, and glue the pieces with `+` (at least one side of each `+` must already be a `std::string`).

Write a small helper *above* `format_hms`, `std::string pad2(int v)`, that returns `std::to_string(v)` with a `"0"` prepended when `v < 10`. Note that `"0" + v` does NOT do that: adding an `int` to a string literal is pointer arithmetic, not concatenation. Convert to `std::string` first.
